three-man-team.title: Three Man Team
three-man-team.description: Structured software development with Architect, Builder, and Reviewer roles — plan, build, review, deploy with playbook-driven discipline.

interface.shortDescription: Architect → Builder → Reviewer workflow for structured coding
interface.longDescription: Transform your Codex session into a structured three-agent team. You are the Architect — plan with playbooks, write structured briefs, spawn Builder and Reviewer sub-agents, and gate deploys through review. Includes Pre-Flight Check planning discipline, diagnosis protocol, brief calibration examples, and token-optimization rules.
defaultPrompt: I need to plan and build a feature with Three Man Team — Architect, Builder, Reviewer
Use the Three Man Team methodology for this task
I want to start a TMT session — write a brief, spin up Builder and Reviewer
Help me diagnose a bug using the TMT playbook
